title: Compute Madelung Potentials for Orthophosphates
action: For each provided orthophosphate compound, read its structural parameters (average A–P distance, effective coordination number, Pauling electronegativities). Compute the multiple‑bond ionicity I using the formula based on electronegativity differences and formal charges, then evaluate the total Madelung potential V_M(P) as the sum of a nearest‑neighbour PO₄ contribution and an external lattice term (ionicity‑corrected). Write the results to a JSON file.
description: JSON array of objects, each with keys 'compound' (string) and 'V_M' (float, eV).
output_schema: A JSON array of objects, each with 'compound' (string) and 'V_M' (float, electronvolts). Example: [{"compound": "Na3PO4", "V_M": -16.75}, ...]
